typography.rationale: DM Sans delivers timeless clarity with gentle geometry—trustworthy and unflashy for Classic credibility. Source Serif 4 adds editorial gravitas for longer reads (case studies, POVs) while remaining highly legible. The sans–serif mix differentiates roles: concise, modern headlines with measured, authoritative narratives beneath—reassuring buyers who value established reliability.

brand_voice.voice_summary: Outreach is courteous and confident, referencing relevant wins and inviting a brief diagnostic. On the site, we emphasize tenure signals—process maturity, governance, and steady outcomes over time. We never chase trends or make aggressive claims. Filter: if it doesn’t reinforce reliability and continuity, it’s trimmed.

why_these_colors: Steel blue-charcoal primaries communicate maturity and steadiness, while a cool cyan accent keeps the system contemporary and SaaS-native. High-contrast neutrals support long-form credibility assets—case studies, governance notes, SLAs—aligning with buyers who favor established partners.
